topic: A person discovers the tree they planted as a child has been cut down
text: I walked past the old spot today, the one where I planted that little sapling years ago, back when my arms were small and my hopes were big. It was meant to grow alongside me, a silent witness to the passage of time. Now, there's just an empty space, a missing piece of my childhood. The ground is bare, almost as if nothing was ever there. I can still remember the day we planted it, the feel of the soil, the excitement of watching it sprout its first leaves. It’s strange how much a tree can hold, how it can become a part of you. I guess things change, even the ones we least expect to.
